dataset_authoring_method: Provisional synthetic evaluation: templates applied to catalog rows and taxonomy. Not independently authored or human-validated. Freeze before tuning; review labels.

limitations: Runs the parser and catalog tool with prior user turns; it does not simulate assistant messages or selected-item state.
Alternative and first-item-reference metrics check parsed intent/reference only; they do not prove that a new SKU or the selected first SKU was returned.
Alternative metrics measure parser intent recognition, not unseen-product novelty.
First-item references are excluded from tool-scope metrics because this harness has no assistant-visible ordering; the live session API smoke checks the SKU and price.
Synthetic conversation labels require human review and do not measure response naturalness.
